instruction: The SQLite database 'Database for tasks.sqlite3' in the current directory has tables: CATEGORY(WARE, CLASS) - which category (CLASS) a ware belongs to (a ware may belong to several categories); MANUFACTURER(BILL_ID, COMPANY) - bills of materials and the companies owning them; MATERIAL(BILL_ID, WARE, AMOUNT) - materials used by a bill; PRODUCT(BILL_ID, WARE, AMOUNT, PRICE) - wares produced by a bill, with amount and price. A bill may produce several wares. Get all the unique wares in alphabetical order that can be produced using nothing besides wares in Mineral category (i.e. products of a bill all of whose materials belong to the Mineral category). Write one ware per line. Compute the answer with bash (sqlite3 and/or python3). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
